import os
from services.rag import ingest

def ingest_varsity():
    content_dir = "backend/content"
    if not os.listdir(content_dir):
        with open(os.path.join(content_dir, "direct_vs_regular_plans.md"), "w") as f:
            f.write("# Direct vs Regular Plans\n\nThis is a primer on direct vs regular plans.")
        with open(os.path.join(content_dir, "expense_ratio_ter.md"), "w") as f:
            f.write("# Expense Ratio / TER\n\nThis is a primer on expense ratio and TER.")
        with open(os.path.join(content_dir, "emergency_fund_basics.md"), "w") as f:
            f.write("# Emergency Fund Basics\n\nThis is a primer on emergency fund basics.")
    for file in os.listdir(content_dir):
        if file.endswith(".md"):
            ingest(os.path.join(content_dir, file))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ingest_varsity()
